---
applyTo: 'backend/**/*.go,backend/internal/db/queries/**/*.sql,backend/migrations/**/*.sql,backend/sqlc.yaml'
---

Review backend changes through the Go API ownership model. The API connects to
Postgres with pgx/pgxpool, migrations are goose SQL, and typed DB access is
generated by sqlc from `backend/internal/db/queries/`.

Require explicit ownership predicates on owned-resource reads, updates, and
deletes even when RLS also protects the table. RLS policies use the
transaction-local `app.user_id` setting and must fail closed when it is unset.
Transactions are owned through their account, not by a direct `user_id` column.

Token consume paths must stay atomic and one-time. Password, reset,
verification, refresh, and logout behavior should preserve enumeration safety
and the OpenAPI error shape.

Generated Go under `backend/internal/openapi/` is reviewed only for whether it
matches a contract regeneration; do not ask for hand edits there.

Relevant validation is `cd backend && go vet ./...` and `cd backend && go test ./...`.
For DB/RLS-sensitive changes, expect the CI backend job to run migrations and
live Postgres tests.
